catalog.effectText: UPDATED: At the start of your turn, Purge Juggernaut taps and moves to an adjacent location. Kill all other minions there.

catalog.name: Quagmire
catalog.effectText: Genesis → Until your next turn, units are Immobile while they occupy nearby sites.

catalog.name: Quarrelsome Kobolds
catalog.effectText: At the end of your turn, Quarrelsome Kobolds strike themselves or another target adjacent unit.
catalog.flavorText: “He started it!” — The one that started it

catalog.name: Queen of Midland
catalog.effectText: After an opponent draws a card, if they have more cards than you, you may draw a card.
catalog.flavorText: Only a fool outshines the sun.

catalog.name: Raal Dromedary
catalog.flavorText:
“And a coarse grace remained: his head was high,
 Though his gaunt flanks with a great mange were worn:
 There was not any yearning in his eye,
 But on his lips and nostril infinite scorn.”
 — Archibald Young Campbell

catalog.name: Rain of Arrows
catalog.effectText: Deal 1 damage to each aboveground minion.
catalog.flavorText:
"Then we will fight in the shade!"
— Dienekes

catalog.name: Raise Dead
catalog.effectText: Summon a random dead minion.
catalog.flavorText: "The living need the dead far more than the dead need the living." — Thomas Laqueur

catalog.name: Recall
catalog.effectText: Teleport any number of allied minions to the caster’s location.

catalog.name: Recurring Specter
catalog.effectText:
Can't defend.

May be cast from your cemetery.

catalog.name: Red Desert
catalog.effectText: Genesis → Deal 1 damage to each minion atop target nearby site.

catalog.name: Remote Desert
catalog.effectText: Genesis → Deal 1 damage to each minion atop target nearby site.

catalog.name: Replication
catalog.effectText: Conjure a copy of an artifact carried by the caster.
catalog.flavorText: "A great sorcerer does not imitate; he plagiarizes."

catalog.name: Rest in Peace
catalog.effectText: Whenever a Spirit or Undead minion occupies affected land sites, burrow it.

catalog.name: Riddle Sphinx
catalog.effectText:
Airborne

Genesis → Look at your topmost spell. You may put it on the bottom of your spellbook, then an opponent may exchange your top and bottommost spells. Draw a card.

catalog.name: Rift Valley
catalog.effectText: You may pull apart a partial row or column to make a void in which to play this.

catalog.name: Rimland Nomads
catalog.effectText:
Movement +1

Takes no damage from Deserts.
catalog.flavorText: As the sands shift, so shall we.

catalog.name: Riptide
catalog.effectText: Target water site pulls in an aboveground unit it's adjacent to. Draw a card.

catalog.name: River of Flame
catalog.effectText: Fire Spellcaster

catalog.name: Roaming Monster
catalog.effectText: May be summoned to any site.
catalog.flavorText: Heeere's Brawny!

catalog.name: Rolling Boulder
catalog.effectText: Units here have “Tap → Give Rolling Boulder a push. It rolls as far as possible and deals 4 damage to each other unit along its path.”

catalog.name: Root Spider
catalog.effectText:
Burrowing

While Root Spider is burrowed, minions directly above it are disabled.

catalog.name: Roots of Yggdrasil
catalog.effectText: When the Roots of Yggdrasil are destroyed, destroy everything.

catalog.name: Royal Bodyguard
catalog.effectText: If a nearby Avatar or royalty (King, Queen, Prince, or Princess) would take damage, Royal Bodyguard may take that damage instead.

catalog.name: Rubble
catalog.effectText: Provides no mana.

catalog.name: Ruby Core
catalog.effectText: Provides (F) and ① to its controller.

catalog.name: Ruins
catalog.flavorText: What do lines on a map mean to the sand and the sun and the wind?

catalog.name: Ruler of Thul
catalog.effectText:
Charge

Allies can move as if the top and bottom edges of the realm were connected. Other allies occupying sites there have +1 power.

catalog.name: Rustic Village
catalog.effectText: Genesis → You may pay ① to summon a Foot Soldier token here.

catalog.name: Sacred Scarabs
catalog.effectText:
Airborne

Deathrite → Deal 3 damage to each unit here.
catalog.flavorText: It’s all fun and games until someone steps on a bug.

catalog.name: Sand Worm
catalog.effectText: Burrowing, Landbound
catalog.flavorText: Only a soft susurration betrays the passing of these desert leviathans far beneath your feet.

catalog.name: Sandstorm
catalog.effectText:
Affected sites and units atop them can't be attacked or intercepted.

At the start of your turn, dispel Sandstorm.

catalog.name: Scarecrow
catalog.effectText:
Genesis → Return each Airborne minion here to its owner’s hand.

 Airborne minions can't enter this location.

catalog.name: Scavenging Fiend
catalog.effectText: Genesis → Conjure a broken artifact to this location.

catalog.name: Scent Hounds
catalog.effectText: Nearby enemies permanently lose Stealth.
catalog.flavorText: For the upwardly mobile of the Midland Court, accolades in the Royal Hunt of the Mist were as treasured as any war-time achievement.

catalog.name: Scorched Earth
catalog.effectText: Choose any number of sites you control. Destroy each of those sites and everything there.

catalog.name: Scourge Zombies
catalog.effectText: Whenever an allied Mortal dies on land, you may summon Scourge Zombies from your cemetery to its location, tapped.

catalog.name: Screaming Skull
catalog.effectText: Whenever bearer attacks and kills an enemy, it untaps.

catalog.name: Sea Raider
catalog.effectText: Whenever Sea Raider attacks and kills an enemy, its controller discards their topmost spell. You may cast that spell once this turn, ignoring threshold.

catalog.name: Sea Serpent
catalog.effectText: Submerge, Waterbound
catalog.flavorText: The study of sea serpents advances one funeral at a time.

catalog.name: Seasoned Sellsword
catalog.effectText: Avatars nearby have "Discard a card → Gain control of Seasoned Sellsword."

catalog.name: Secret Tunnel
catalog.effectText: Burrowed allies can move as if this were adjacent to your other sites.

catalog.name: Sedge Crabs
catalog.effectText: Can only move themselves sideways.
catalog.flavorText:
“One will never make the crab walk straight.“
— Aristophanes

catalog.name: Seer
catalog.effectText:
Tap → Play or draw a site.

At the start of your turn, look at your topmost site or spell. You may put it on the bottom of its deck.

catalog.name: Seirawan Hydra
catalog.effectText: UPDATED: Immediately heals from damage that doesn't kill it.
catalog.flavorText: "Fell the tree, and the branches are soon cut off." — Francis Quarles

catalog.name: Selfsame Simulacrum
catalog.effectText: May be summoned as a basic copy of a nearby minion.
catalog.flavorText: Common folk view their lives through a half-silvered mirror, seeing only their own reflection.

catalog.name: Seven-League Boots
catalog.effectText: Bearer has Movement +7.
catalog.flavorText: “Bring me my boots at once, so that I may catch them!“ — Charles Perrault

catalog.name: Shield Maidens
catalog.effectText: Nearby allies take 1 less damage.
catalog.flavorText: My word is my bond, my shield is my service.

catalog.name: Shield Wall
catalog.effectText: Until your next turn, each ally takes 1 less damage for each other ally it's nearby.

catalog.name: Shifting Sands
catalog.effectText: Genesis → Reactivate the Genesis abilities of your nearby Deserts.

catalog.name: Shrink
catalog.effectText: Set the base power of target nearby unit to 0 until your next turn.

catalog.name: Siege Ballista
catalog.effectText: Tap bearer and another ally here → Deal 3 damage to target unit up to two steps away.

catalog.name: Silence
catalog.effectText: UPDATED: Minions occupying affected sites are silenced.

catalog.name: Silver Valkyries
catalog.effectText:
Airborne

At the end of your turn, untap all allies here.

catalog.name: Simple Village
catalog.effectText: Genesis → You may pay ① to summon a Foot Soldier token here.

catalog.name: Sinkhole
catalog.effectText: Sacrifice Sinkhole → Destroy a nearby site.

catalog.name: Sirian Templar
catalog.effectText: Takes no damage from Demon, Spirit, or Undead minions.
catalog.flavorText: Struck down, the templar rose again, guided by his holy purpose—and the dawn rose with him.

catalog.name: Sirocco Scorpions
catalog.effectText: Lethal
catalog.flavorText: Tread light! And hasten thee away from skittering cinders, sun-scorched obsidian shards asway.

catalog.name: Sisters of Silence
catalog.effectText: UPDATED: Other nearby minions are silenced.
catalog.flavorText: “Since long I’ve held silence as a remedy for harm.” — Aeschylus

catalog.name: Skirmishers of Mu
catalog.effectText:
Ranged

During basic movement, Skirmishers of Mu may perform a ranged strike from any location along their path.

catalog.name: Sky Baron
catalog.effectText:
Airborne

All other minions lose Airborne.

catalog.name: Sleep
catalog.effectText: Target minion at a location up to two steps away falls asleep. It's disabled until it takes damage.
catalog.flavorText: Breathe deep the gathering bloom.

catalog.name: Sling Pixies
catalog.effectText:
Airborne, Ranged

Takes no damage from units with 4 or more power.

catalog.name: Slumbering Giantess
catalog.effectText: Genesis → Fall asleep. Slumbering Giantess is disabled until hurt.

catalog.name: Smokestacks of Gnaak
catalog.effectText: Other nearby sites lose their abilities.

catalog.name: Sneak Thief
catalog.effectText:
Stealth

Tap → Steal an artifact out of the hands of another target unit here, and stay Stealthed.

catalog.name: Snow Leopard
catalog.flavorText:
“This is the Le-o-pard, my child,
His temper’s anything but mild.”
― A. M. Shaw & C. Beckwith

catalog.name: Sorcerer
catalog.effectText:
Tap → Play or draw a site.

Tap → Draw a spell.

catalog.name: Sparkmage
catalog.effectText:
Tap → Play or draw a site.

Tap → Target nearby location. Deal damage to another random unit there equal to the sum of (A) on spells you've cast this turn.

catalog.name: Spear of Destiny
catalog.effectText: Bearer has “Tap → Throw Spear of Destiny at any minion anywhere. It teleports to that minion’s location and kills it.”
catalog.flavorText: Nor mortal's blood shall sate a hunger erst whetted by divine.

catalog.name: Spectral Stalker
catalog.effectText: Voidwalk
catalog.flavorText:
“We live on a placid island of ignorance in the midst of black seas of infinity, and it was not meant that we should voyage far.”
― H. P. Lovecraft

catalog.name: Spin Attack
catalog.effectText: An ally strikes each enemy at its location.

catalog.name: Spire Lich
catalog.effectText: If Spire Lich is atop a Tower, it has +2 power, Ranged, and Spellcaster.

catalog.name: Spring River
catalog.effectText: Genesis → Look at your next spell. You may put it on the bottom of your spellbook.

catalog.name: Squirming Mass
catalog.effectText: UPDATED: Whenever another nearby minion dies, Squirming Mass permanently gains its power.

catalog.name: Standing Stones
catalog.effectText: Minions here are Spellcasters.

catalog.name: Star-seeds of Uhr
catalog.effectText: Fill up to thirteen voids with Rubble.
catalog.flavorText: For each layer of ruin excavated, another calamity of yore was revealed.

catalog.name: Steppe
catalog.flavorText: There's beauty in the simplicity of empty horizons.

catalog.name: Stone-gaze Gorgons
catalog.effectText: Other minions at rest at adjacent locations are disabled.
catalog.flavorText: In the gleam of his unblooded sword, Veslin unwittingly beheld a sight no mortal had yet lived to unsee.

catalog.name: Stormy Seas
catalog.effectText: Submerge all minions and artifacts occupying target water site.
catalog.flavorText: The sea is angry today, my friends; hike and hold, men, fly! Bring due astern Neptune's belly!

catalog.name: Summer River
catalog.effectText: Genesis → Look at your next spell. You may put it on the bottom of your spellbook.

catalog.name: Summoning Sphere
catalog.effectText: You may summon minions to affected sites.
catalog.flavorText: "The icy earth swung blind and blackening in the moonless air. Morn came and went—and came, and brought no day." — Lord Byron

catalog.name: Sunken Treasure
catalog.effectText:
If cast, conjure this under an allied water site of an opponent's choice.

When Sunken Treasure is carried to the surface, its controller sacrifices it and draws two cards.

catalog.name: Swamp Buffalo
catalog.flavorText: Impassive, plump, and peaceful, the swamp buffalo is an icon of contentment.

catalog.name: Swan Maidens
catalog.effectText: Airborne, Submerge
catalog.flavorText: Before woman was, the water awaited her.

catalog.name: Swiven Scout
catalog.effectText:
Movement +1

Enemy Avatars within Swiven Scout's range of motion play with their hands revealed.
catalog.flavorText:
"Know thine enemy and know thyself, and feel not the awe of a hundred battles."
— Sun Tzu

catalog.name: Tadpole Pool
catalog.effectText: (W)(W)(W) — Genesis → Summon three submerged Frog tokens here.

catalog.name: Telekinesis
catalog.effectText: Caster snatches and picks up target nearby artifact they can carry.
catalog.flavorText: “If it’s in my hand, it’s mine.” — Toddler’s first rule.

catalog.name: Teleport
catalog.effectText: Teleport an ally to the surface of target site.
catalog.flavorText:
“There was no real sense of time passing, and in the last act it felt like everyone was just teleporting everywhere.“
— Highland Theater Critic

catalog.name: The Colour Out of Space
catalog.effectText: Provides no mana or threshold if not adjacent to the void.

catalog.name: The Geistwood
catalog.effectText: Genesis abilities here are also Deathrite abilities.

catalog.name: The Immortal Throne
catalog.effectText:
Whenever anyone plays a card with cost equal to the number of level counters on The Immortal Throne, they draw a card and add a level counter.

At level 8 or more, an Avatar here alone wins the game.

catalog.name: Thunderstorm
catalog.effectText:
At the end of your turn, deal 3 damage to a random unit atop affected sites, then you may move Thunderstorm one step.

Lasts 3 of your turns.

catalog.name: Tide Naiads
catalog.effectText:
Submerge

This site is flooded. It is a water site.

catalog.name: Torshammar Trinket
catalog.effectText: UPDATED: Bearer has +1 power. After each turn, return this to its owner’s hand.

catalog.name: Tragedy Worrywart
catalog.effectText: Units nearby take no damage from Magic spells.
catalog.flavorText: He frets incessantly to preserve the life he's not living.

catalog.name: Tringh Constrictor
catalog.effectText: Tap → Tringh Constrictor may take a step, then it constricts target minion here and carries it disabled. The next time Tringh Constrictor would untap, it instead kills that minion if it's still constricted.

catalog.name: Truesight Crossbow
catalog.effectText: UPDATED: Bearer has Ranged and can see stealthed enemies.

catalog.name: Tufted Turtles
catalog.effectText: The first time Tuft Turtles would take damage each turn, prevent that damage.
catalog.flavorText: A turtle is never without a castle—or a coffin.

catalog.name: Tvinnax Berserker
catalog.effectText:
Whenever Tvinnax Berserker can attack a unit, he must.

Untap Tvinnax Berserker whenever he attacks and kills an enemy minion.
catalog.flavorText: Most folk share naught with berserkers save for being, and even that not for long.

catalog.name: Twist of Fate
catalog.effectText: Exchange life totals with target opponent. (X) is the difference between your life totals.

catalog.name: Ultimate Horror
catalog.effectText:
Airborne, Voidwalk

Genesis → Summon each other dead Voidwalk minion to a nearby site or void.

catalog.name: Undertaker Engine
catalog.effectText: At the end of your turn, you may burrow and/or unburrow any combination of artifacts and minions at this site.

catalog.name: Undertow
catalog.effectText: Genesis → Staying within this body of water, move target unit one step.

catalog.name: Unland Angler
catalog.effectText:
Submerge

At the start of your turn, if Unland Angler is submerged, force each enemy minion atop adjacent sites to take a step toward this one.

catalog.name: Unland Eel
catalog.effectText:
Submerge

Whenever Unland Eel submerges, it may drag another minion here down with it.

catalog.name: Unlikely Alliance
catalog.effectText: Draw a card for each rarity among allied minions.
catalog.flavorText: "There are three rules for winning a war. Unfortunately, nobody knows what they are."

catalog.name: Unravel
catalog.effectText: Destroy all artifacts and Undead minions at a location up to two steps away.
catalog.flavorText: “My heart, why come you here alone? The wild thing of my heart is grown, to be a thing, fairy, and wild, and fair, and whole.” — G. P. T. Branwen

catalog.name: Updraft Ridge
catalog.effectText: UPDATED: Airborne minions atop Updraft Ridge move freely away.

catalog.name: Upwelling
catalog.effectText: Target a nearby site. Return each artifact and minion there to its owner's hand.
catalog.flavorText: There is no height to which confident fools cannot ascend.

catalog.name: Vanguard Knights
catalog.effectText: Vanguard Knights have +2 power if they alone are the furthest forward of your units.

catalog.name: Vantage Hills
catalog.effectText: Ranged units atop this site have +1 range.

catalog.name: Vaults of Zul
catalog.effectText: The first time an Avatar stops here, they draw three cards and skip their next turn.

catalog.name: Vesuvius
catalog.effectText: (F)(F)(F) — Sacrifice Vesuvius → Each unit occupying nearby sites takes 3 damage.

catalog.name: Vile Imp
catalog.effectText: Genesis → May deal 2 damage to target adjacent unit.
catalog.flavorText: One good burn deserves another.

catalog.name: Vril Revenant
catalog.effectText:
Voidwalk

① → Gain +1 power this turn.

catalog.name: Wall of Air
catalog.effectText:
Conjure atop the border of a site you control.

Minions with Airborne or 2 or less power can't traverse Wall of Air.

catalog.name: Wall of Fire
catalog.effectText:
Conjure atop the border of a site you control.

Whenever a unit passes through Wall of Fire, it takes 3 damage.

catalog.name: Wall of Ice
catalog.effectText:
Conjure atop the border of a site you control.

Units can't traverse Wall of Ice on the ground.

catalog.name: Warp Spasm
catalog.effectText: This turn, double an allied minion's power, and whenever it attacks and kills a unit, it untaps. At the end of the turn, it dies.

catalog.name: Watchtower
catalog.effectText: Enemy units atop nearby sites permanently lose Stealth.

catalog.name: Waveshaper
catalog.effectText:
Tap → Play or draw a site.

Tap → Flood a site near your body of water until you do so again. Tap minions without submerge there. They don't untap the next time they would.

catalog.name: Wayfaring Pilgrim
catalog.effectText: Whenever Wayfaring Pilgrim enters each corner of the realm for the first time, you may draw a card.

catalog.name: Waypoint Portal
catalog.effectText: Choose two different sites. This turn, units can move between them as if they were adjacent.

catalog.name: Whirling Blades
catalog.effectText: An ally may take up to two steps, and then strikes each enemy along their entire path.

catalog.name: Wicked Witch
catalog.effectText:
Spellcaster

Other nearby minions have -2 power.
catalog.flavorText: What sense in hoping for death, with nothing left to die for?

catalog.name: Wicker Manikin
catalog.effectText: Non-fire Spellcaster
catalog.flavorText: By twisted frame round willow's heart, let none disclaim my turner's art.

catalog.name: Wild Boars
catalog.flavorText: Twere once again drowsy, when all in a rush, wild boar came a-snuffling, straight out of the brush!

catalog.name: Wildfire
catalog.effectText:
Conjure Wildfire atop a single site nearby.

At the end of each turn, each unit here takes 3 damage, then move Wildfire to an adjacent location it hasn't visited before. If none remain, dispel Wildfire.

catalog.name: Wills-o'-the-Wisp
catalog.effectText:
Voidwalk

Whenever Wills-o’-the-Wisp are attacked, they may teleport to another nearby location or void to evade the attack.

catalog.name: Wind Sylph
catalog.effectText:
Airborne, Air Spellcaster

After Wind Sylph casts a Magic spell, she may push a unit here one step.

catalog.name: Windblast
catalog.effectText: Push everything atop sites one step in a cardinal direction.

catalog.name: Windmill
catalog.flavorText: The wind's wild words, in uncertain surges, whisper how the world was made.

catalog.name: Wings of Invention
catalog.effectText: Bearer has Airborne and Movement +1, if it's a minion.

catalog.name: Witherwing Hero
catalog.effectText:
Airborne

Whenever a weaker allied minion here is attacked, you may return it to its owner's hand.

catalog.name: Wraetannis Titan
catalog.effectText: Genesis → Strike each enemy here.
catalog.flavorText: O valley low, innocent dove What grievous blows rain from above

catalog.name: Wrath of the Sea
catalog.effectText: Flood all sites adjacent to a body of water this turn. Then submerge all minions and artifacts on water.

catalog.name: Yokai Kappas
catalog.effectText: Discard a water site → Untap Yokai Kappas. Use only once per turn.
catalog.flavorText: In the cool winter months when cucurbits don't grow, kappas of the Yokai forest find other means of refreshment.

catalog.name: Yourke Crossbowmen
catalog.effectText:
Ranged

Takes no damage from ranged strikes.
catalog.flavorText: Corin's shield wracked and shivered like a plucked bowstring—but held!—while he reloaded.

catalog.name: Zephyranne Airship
catalog.effectText:
Airborne, Movement +2

May carry any number of allied minions.

catalog.name: Adtonitum
catalog.effectText:
Airborne, Movement +1

Whenever Adtonitum stops, she may deal 3 damage to another random unit there.

catalog.name: Caelestis
catalog.effectText:
Airborne, Voidwalk

Tap → The next Dragon you cast to this location costs (0) this turn.

catalog.name: Cradle of Etherrum
catalog.effectText:
Any time during your turn, you may look at your next spell.

You may cast Dragons from the top of your spellbook here for (1) less.

catalog.name: Draco Corvus
catalog.effectText:
Airborne, Stealth

Tap → Teleport to target tapped minion to burrow it.

catalog.name: Dragonlord
catalog.effectText:
Tap → Play or draw a site.

Before setup, set aside a Unique Dragon. Once on your turn, if you meet its threshold, you may pay (3) to gain its abilities this turn.

catalog.name: Dragonlord's Lair
catalog.effectText: Dragons cast to this site require no threshold and cost (1) less.

catalog.name: Ignis Rex
catalog.effectText:
Airborne, Immune to fire damage

Once on your turn, discard a fire card → Deal 3 damage to units at target adjacent location.

catalog.name: Kairos the Archivist
catalog.effectText:
Genesis → Archive the state of the realm.
Deathrite → Return all archived cards to their recorded state. Then banish Kairos.

catalog.name: Moonsong Talagelum
catalog.effectText:
Airborne

Counts as a Grey Wolves and has +1 power for each other Grey Wolves nearby.

catalog.name: Shrine of the Dragonlord
catalog.effectText:
Genesis → Teleport all Dragons here.

This site provides an additional (1) and (E)(F)(W)(A).

catalog.name: Talamh Dreig
catalog.effectText:
Can't be moved by force.

Has +1 power for each adjacent site.

catalog.name: Vatn Draconis
catalog.effectText:
Submerge

At the end of your turn, you may submerge all minions and artifacts here.

catalog.name: Xeraphine Konrul
catalog.effectText:
Airborne

At the end of your turn, you may choose three of your dead minions. Banish two to return the remaining one to hand.

catalog.name: Aaj-kegon Ghost Crabs
catalog.effectText:
Submerge, Voidwalk

Has +1 power for each void in their row.
catalog.flavorText: The blacker the night, the keener the claw.

catalog.name: Abaddon Succubus
catalog.effectText: Once on your turn, may lure target adjacent enemy minion to take a step closer. When it arrives, it takes 2 damage and you heal 2.

catalog.name: Abyssal Assault
catalog.effectText: For each point of its power, an allied Monster may deal 1 damage to a unit in a square near it.

catalog.name: Accursed Desert
catalog.effectText: Genesis → Break nearby Wards.

catalog.name: Accursed Tower
catalog.effectText: Genesis → Break nearby Wards.

catalog.name: Accusation
catalog.effectText: Target opponent reveals their hand and banishes a card. If any of their cards or allies are Evil, you may choose which.

catalog.name: Acid Rain
catalog.effectText: Silence affected sites and artifacts there.
catalog.flavorText: This is the way the world ends—not with a bang but a drizzle.

catalog.name: Active Volcano
catalog.flavorText: What power, what purpose, what people dared forge a face in living fire?

catalog.name: Aethermoeba
catalog.effectText:
Voidwalk

Moves by expanding from any part of itself. It occupies all locations it has ever occupied, and has +1 power for each one that is void.

catalog.name: Aino
catalog.effectText: At the end of your turn, Aino may take a step between the top and bottom edges of the realm to gain Stealth.

catalog.name: Alabaster Box
catalog.effectText: Whenever a minion dies nearby, you heal 1.

catalog.name: Algae Bloom
catalog.effectText: Genesis → Provides (A)(E)(F) this turn.

catalog.name: Algor Omphalos
catalog.effectText:
Earth and Water Spellcaster

At the end of your turn, this Omphalos draws a spell, which only it can cast. Minions it casts must be summoned here.

catalog.name: All Mortals Gone
catalog.effectText: Kill all Mortals.

catalog.name: Altar of Malachai
catalog.effectText: Once per game, if you would die, you may sacrifice a minion atop this Altar instead.

catalog.name: Angel Ascendant
catalog.effectText: Has Airborne and +1 power while Warded.
catalog.flavorText: Wings were not granted, but uncovered—folded deep within the stillness of surrender.

catalog.name: Angry Mob
catalog.effectText: Genesis → Kill target adjacent Unique or Elite minion.
catalog.flavorText: A single shout ignites a wildfire in the field of their discontent.

catalog.name: Animist
catalog.effectText:
Tap → Play or draw a site.

You may cast magics in your hand as Spirits with power equal to their cost.

catalog.name: Apostles of Thamariel
catalog.effectText: Genesis → Search your top seven spells. You may summon an Angel from among them, then shuffle. The Angel is banished if the Apostles ever leave the realm.

catalog.name: Apply Alkahest
catalog.effectText: Destroy all minions, artifacts, and auras at target nearby site.

catalog.name: Arcade of Bones
catalog.effectText: While in this row, Undead move freely and can't be targeted or damaged by magic.
catalog.flavorText: The way is straight, the toll is breath.

catalog.name: Archangel Gabriel
catalog.effectText:
Airborne, Ward

Genesis -> Choose another allied minion. They draw a spell, which only they can cast.

catalog.name: Archangel Michael
catalog.effectText:
Airborne, Ward

Genesis → Michael takes a step, then strikes all enemies at his location.

catalog.name: Archangel Raphael
catalog.effectText:
Airborne, Ward

Genesis → Strike or Ward a nearby Avatar.

catalog.name: Archangel Samael
catalog.effectText:
Airborne, Ward

Genesis → Players lose 1 life for each Evil minion they control or in their cemetery.

catalog.name: Arjaro Exorcist
catalog.effectText:
Spellcaster

Genesis → Banish target adjacent Demon, Spirit, or aura.

catalog.name: Armageddon
catalog.effectText: Destroy everything.
catalog.flavorText: The heavens shall pass in a great shattering, and the elements shall melt with a fervent heat; the earth also, and all its works therein shall be burned up and by flame undone. — 2 Peter 3:10

catalog.name: Army of the Dead
catalog.effectText: Whenever this Army moves or takes damage, it leaves a Skeleton token behind.
catalog.flavorText: Less army than avalanche, their numbers never seemed to dwindle.

catalog.name: Asmodeus

catalog.effectText: You may banish minions under your control, or from your hand or cemetery, to help cast the Colossus. It costs (1) less to cast for each.

catalog.name: Ice Shards
catalog.effectText: Shoot three projectiles, one at a time. Each deals 1 damage but melts before the third step.
catalog.flavorText: Flesh, frost, and folly all meet the same end.

catalog.name: Ignited
catalog.effectText:
Charge

Dies at the end of your turn.
catalog.flavorText: Necromancy's spark meets pyromancy's spite.

catalog.name: Imposter
catalog.effectText:
Tap → Play or draw a site.

(3) → Banish an Avatar from your collection to mask yourself. Gain their abilities until damaged or until you put on a new mask.

catalog.name: Infusion Factory
catalog.effectText: Adjacent artifacts are Automatons with 2 power and their own bearer abilities.

catalog.name: Innsmouth Dock
catalog.effectText: Once on your turn, you may lure an adjacent minion to step here.

catalog.name: Instigator Imp
catalog.effectText: Genesis → Make two enemy minions at target nearby location fight each other.
catalog.flavorText: Wherever he grins, someone bleeds.

catalog.name: Interrogator
catalog.effectText:
Tap → Play or draw a site.

Whenever an ally strikes an enemy Avatar, draw a spell unless they pay 3 life.

catalog.name: Into the Abyss
catalog.effectText: Submerge target minion, or pull it into a void it's adjacent to.
catalog.flavorText: Dig deep enough, and you'll either find sumpin'—or be sumpin'.

catalog.name: Intrepid Hero
catalog.effectText: Lethal to Evil.
catalog.flavorText: No banner but blood, no ally but resolve.

catalog.name: Invigorate
catalog.effectText: An ally gains +3 power this turn and you heal 3.

catalog.name: Iron Maiden
catalog.effectText: Whenever a nearby Avatar draws a card, they lose life equal to the number of cards they've drawn this turn.

catalog.name: Ironclad
catalog.effectText:
Tap → Play or draw a site.

Takes 2 less damage.

catalog.name: Jack the Ripper
catalog.effectText:
Stealth

May be cast to any Mortal, silencing then killing them, without breaking Stealth.

catalog.name: Key to the City
catalog.effectText:
Provides (1).

Bearer ignores site abilities.
catalog.flavorText: Locks are for the uninvited.

catalog.name: Khamaseen Mummy
catalog.effectText:
Burrowing

Whenever this unburrows, you may trigger the Genesis of a nearby Desert.

catalog.name: Kiss of Death
catalog.effectText:
May be cast by Spirits and Undead.

Kill target minion here.
catalog.flavorText: Her lips promised a peace he could no longer refuse.

catalog.name: Kiss of Judas
catalog.effectText: This turn, attacks against target Avatar can't be defended and you draw a card whenever they are attacked.

catalog.name: Kissers of Wounds
catalog.effectText: Genesis → Ward a wounded minion nearby, or you heal 2.

catalog.name: Kor Crematory
catalog.effectText: (F)(F)(F)(F) — If a card would be placed in a cemetery, banish it instead.

catalog.name: Koscheis Egg
catalog.effectText: Genesis → Avatar bearer hides its soul in Koschei's Egg, becoming immune to death blows. After three of your turns, or if the Egg leaves the realm, you lose.

catalog.name: Lacuna Entity
catalog.effectText:
Submerge, Voidwalk

Genesis → Drag target weaker minion from an adjacent site to here, ignoring regions.

catalog.name: Landmass
catalog.effectText: Draw a site. You may play a land site.
catalog.flavorText: “Let the dry land appear,” and it was so. — Genesis 1:9

catalog.name: Lash
catalog.effectText: Deal 1 damage to target nearby minion and untap it.

catalog.name: Leadworks
catalog.effectText: Genesis → Until your next turn, sites are silenced while nearby.

catalog.name: Legion of Gall
catalog.effectText:
Airborne

Genesis → Look at a collection and banish three cards from it.

catalog.name: Lesser Blood Demon
catalog.effectText: Genesis → Lose 2 life.
catalog.flavorText: A river for kings, a drop for knaves—yet always blood for the bargain.

catalog.name: Lifewish
catalog.effectText: Fully heal each Avatar.
catalog.flavorText: Life did not spare them. It took them wholly.

catalog.name: Lilith
catalog.effectText: At the end of your turn, reveal opponent’s top spell. If it’s a minion, summon it here. Otherwise, put it at the bottom of the deck.

catalog.name: Locusts of Illyria
catalog.effectText:
Airborne

At the end of your turn, if no new Locusts have been summoned this turn, summon a tapped copy of this nearby.

catalog.name: Lord of Destruction
catalog.effectText: Destroys sites it strikes and other minions there.

catalog.name: Lord of Fear
catalog.effectText: Enemies can't defend alone.
catalog.flavorText: No sword fits a trembling hand.

catalog.name: Lord of Greed
catalog.effectText:
Can't drop artifacts.

At the end of your turn, Lord of Greed snatches an artifact from elsewhere into his hands.

catalog.name: Lord of Lies
catalog.effectText: UPDATED: Once on your turn, you may have two other target units at a nearby location fight.

catalog.name: Lucid Dreamers
catalog.effectText:
Voidwalk

You may cast minions to this void, granting them Voidwalk until they're no longer in the void.

catalog.name: Lure
catalog.effectText: An ally tempts an enemy minion at a nearby site into taking a step closer.

catalog.name: Magician
catalog.effectText:
You have no atlas, but your spellbook may contain sites, and you start with seven cards.

Tap → Play a site.

catalog.name: Maiden, Mother, Crone
catalog.effectText:
Genesis → Heal 3.

(3) → Draw a spell.

Deathrite → Opponent loses 3 life.

catalog.name: Makeshift Barricade
catalog.effectText: If one or more allies here would take damage, prevent it. If the damage was 3 or more, the barricade breaks.
catalog.flavorText: Fear and fury and—furniture.

catalog.name: Malakhim
catalog.effectText:
Airborne, Ward

At the end of your turn, untap Malakhim.

catalog.name: Mandrake Jars
catalog.effectText: Bearer has +1 power and is an Earth Spellcaster.

catalog.name: Martyrs of Tomorrow
catalog.effectText: Deathrite → Ward an allied minion.
catalog.flavorText: There hung a halo, not born of life, but of its willing surrender and noble sacrifice.

catalog.name: Master Necromancer
catalog.effectText:
Spellcaster

Genesis → Summon a Skeleton token to each other adjacent site.

catalog.name: Mayor of Milborne
catalog.effectText: Other nearby Mortals have +1 power.
catalog.flavorText: Vote Reginald II for mayor and keep your family safe!

catalog.name: Màzuj Ifrit
catalog.effectText:
Airborne

At the start of your turn, you lose 2 life.

catalog.name: Meat Hook
catalog.effectText: Bearer has "Tap → Shoot a projectile. If a unit is hit, drag it here, and bearer may fight it when it arrives."

catalog.name: Megalurker
catalog.effectText:
Burrowing

Genesis → If an ally died last turn, Megalurker may drag the killer from an adjacent site to here.

catalog.name: Mephistopheles
catalog.effectText:
Must be cast to your Avatar's location, taking their life and replacing them as your Avatar.

Once on your turn, you may summon an Evil minion from your hand to an adjacent site.

catalog.name: Mesmer Demon
catalog.effectText: Genesis → Tap target adjacent enemy minion and make it step closer.

catalog.name: Mimic
catalog.effectText: As you summon this Mimic, you may transform a carriable artifact into it, under your control.
catalog.flavorText: Turns out, the real monster was the loot we found along the way.

catalog.name: Mismanaged Mortuary
catalog.effectText: Flooded. Treat your opponent's cemetery as yours, and vice versa.

catalog.name: Molten Maar
catalog.effectText: (F)(F) — Genesis → You may cast a Hellhounds from your collection to this site.

catalog.name: Monks of Kobalsa
catalog.effectText: Can't be modified, except by Wards.
catalog.flavorText: Alteration admits imperfection in the maker's design.

catalog.name: Monstermorphosis
catalog.effectText: Disable target nearby minion until your next turn. At the start of that turn, you may transform it into a Monster from your hand or a Horrible Hybrids from your collection.

catalog.name: Mortal Soil
catalog.effectText: Whenever an affected site takes damage, banish a minion from your cemetery to prevent it. If you can't, dispel this.

catalog.name: Moss Troll
catalog.effectText:
Stealth

Loses Stealth if it moves.
catalog.flavorText: Moss grows fat on a troll in stone.

catalog.name: Mount Ussar Sanctuary
catalog.effectText: (E)(E)(E)(E) — When your Avatar arrives at Death's Door, they flee here and gain Ward.

catalog.name: Mountain Peaks
catalog.flavorText: Capricious winds had sculpted the crag, arched and spired like a grand cathedral.

catalog.name: Mover of Mountains
catalog.effectText:
Spellcaster

Once on your turn, you may swap two nearby empty sites.

catalog.name: Muddy Pigs
catalog.effectText: Deathrite → You heal 3.
catalog.flavorText: Well-marbled contentment.

catalog.name: Mudslide
catalog.effectText: Genesis → Slide all units at land sites in this column one step left or right.

catalog.name: Murder of Crows
catalog.effectText: Deal 1 damage to all enemy minions on the surface. You may cast this spell from your cemetery, banishing it afterward.

catalog.name: Myrrh's Trophy Room
catalog.effectText: Provides an additional (1) for each Unique minion in an opponent's cemetery.

catalog.name: Nadir Seed
catalog.effectText: At the end of their turn, this site's controller loses life equal to their unspent mana.
catalog.flavorText: Spend your spark—or it will.

catalog.name: Necromancer
catalog.effectText:
Tap → Play or draw a site.

Once on your turn, you may pay (1) to summon a Skeleton token here.

catalog.name: Necronomiconcert
catalog.effectText: Each differently named Undead and Instrument nearby joins the band to play. Draw a card for each.
catalog.flavorText: Oh, everyone's just dying to attend.

catalog.name: Necropotence
catalog.effectText: Give a nearby allied Undead +3 power this turn.

catalog.name: Nightwatchmen
catalog.effectText: Genesis → Ward this site.
catalog.flavorText: Poorly paid, rarely thanked, profoundly necessary.

catalog.name: No Mans Land
catalog.effectText: Players can't summon minions to this site or to the one directly in front of it.

catalog.name: Noisome Twosome
catalog.effectText: Deathrite → Summon a Skeleton token here.
catalog.flavorText: They put the rank in rank-and-file.

catalog.name: Nommo Monitor
catalog.effectText: Submerge, Voidwalk

catalog.name: Nosferatu
catalog.effectText:
Airborne, Burrowing

Deathrite → Resummon Nosferatu beneath your starting square. If he dies again this turn, banish him instead.

catalog.name: Novice Necromancer
catalog.effectText:
Spellcaster

Genesis → Summon a Skeleton token here.
catalog.flavorText: An unrefined craft, practiced on uncritical subjects.

catalog.name: Noxious Corpse
catalog.effectText: Lethal
catalog.flavorText: First the fever, then the feast.

catalog.name: Old Mortimer's Den
catalog.effectText: When a minion enters here, kill it, then return this site to hand, leaving Rubble behind.

catalog.name: One-shot Wizard
catalog.effectText: Genesis → Shoot a projectile that deals 1 damage, or gain Spellcaster this turn.
catalog.flavorText: A cautionary tale in every lecture thereafter.

catalog.name: Onslaught
catalog.effectText: This turn, allies gain +1 power, Charge, and can't be immobilized, silenced, or disabled.
catalog.flavorText: Momentum makes a fine commander.

catalog.name: Open Grave
catalog.effectText: Genesis → You may pay (1) to summon a Skeleton token here.

catalog.name: Open Mausoleum
catalog.effectText: Genesis → You may pay (1) to summon a Skeleton token here.

catalog.name: Ophanim
catalog.effectText: Airborne, Movement +1, Voidwalk, Ward
catalog.flavorText:
Beyond the veil, they burn and rise—
Eternal watchmen of the skies.

catalog.name: Order of the Pale Worm
catalog.effectText: Nearby sites and units lose Ward
catalog.flavorText:
They crawl through bones, and speak in dust—
No god to name, no voice to trust.

catalog.name: Order of the Sacred Oak
catalog.effectText:
Ward

Your opponent can't destroy nearby sites.
catalog.flavorText: While we draw breath this Heartwood stands. Thus an oath is sworn.

catalog.name: Order of the White Wing
catalog.effectText:
Ward

If a minion would be summoned nearby and it wasn't cast from hand, banish it.
catalog.flavorText: The younger the faith, the fiercer the devotion.

catalog.name: Orm Infestor
catalog.effectText:
Burrowing, Submerge

At the end of your turn, deal 1 damage to this site and you heal 1.

catalog.name: Orpheus' Crossing
catalog.effectText: Genesis → You're on Death's Door until your next turn. Summon a dead minion here.

catalog.name: Overflow
catalog.effectText: Draw a site. You may play a water site.
catalog.flavorText: A generous heart cannot help but spill.

catalog.name: Paladins of Bazia
catalog.effectText: Spellcaster, Ward
catalog.flavorText:
At the breaking of light, they emerge—
not to greet the day, but to judge it worthy.

catalog.name: Panpipes of Pnom
catalog.effectText: Damage caused by nearby units is increased to 2.

catalog.name: Peace Offering
catalog.effectText:
Airborne

Whenever this enters another player's site, you may give them the Peace Offering. If you do, their units can't attack you on their next turn.

catalog.name: Peacemaker Arbalest
catalog.effectText: Bearer has Ranged and its strikes deal 1 more damage to units for each of the following they are: Evil, artifact bearers, spellcasters, voidwalkers, submergers, burrowers, and Frogs.

catalog.name: Peculiar Port
catalog.effectText: (W)(W) — Genesis → You may cast a Horrible Hybrids from your collection to this site.

catalog.name: Penitent Knight
catalog.flavorText:
The other was a softer voice
As soft as honey-dew:
Quoth he, 'The man hath penance done,
And penance more will do.'
— Coleridge

catalog.name: Persecutor
catalog.effectText:
Tap → Play or draw a site.

Once on your turn, Persecutor may step toward the closest Evil, or brand an enemy so your cards treat them as Evil this turn.

catalog.name: Pied Piper of Hameln
catalog.effectText: You control all minions with 1 or less power.
catalog.flavorText:
For silver's weight cleared croft and glen
then charmed the sons of men from men.

catalog.name: Pile of Skulls
catalog.effectText: Once on your turn, you may banish a card from a cemetery to summon a Skeleton token here.

catalog.name: Pilgrims Shrine
catalog.effectText: Ward. When a minion leaves here, transfer this site's Ward to it.

catalog.name: Pith Imp
catalog.effectText:
Airborne

Genesis → Steals a random spell from your opponent's hand until it leaves the realm.
catalog.flavorText: He's not much of a reader, but he adores the illustrations.

catalog.name: Plague Pits
catalog.effectText: Genesis → If there are three or more dead minions, banish all cemeteries.

catalog.name: Plague Rat
catalog.effectText: Lethal

catalog.effectText: Each Avatar sacrifices all of their minions, permanently gaining +1 power for each.
catalog.flavorText: Victory requires but one—the victor.

catalog.effectText: Has 0 power unless adjacent to an Evil ally.
catalog.flavorText: It loomed upon the ashen hill, a dark sentinel with eyes of fire—unjudging, yet complicit, drawn not to purity but to the weight of man's fall.

catalog.effectText: Whenever an Evil minion dies nearby, its controller loses 1 life.

catalog.name: Putrid Presence
catalog.effectText:
Submerge, Burrowing

catalog.name: Ravenous Werewolf
catalog.effectText: Charge, Movement +1
catalog.flavorText: The man starves while the monster feasts.

catalog.name: Raze
catalog.effectText: An ally destroys its site and all artifacts there.

catalog.name: Realm-Eater
catalog.effectText:
Tap → Play, draw, or digest a site.

Destroys sites it successfully attacks, then becomes immobile until it digests.

catalog.name: Red Rock of Ravannis
catalog.effectText:
Artifacts can't be carried here.

At the end of each turn, pull each artifact one step towards this site, along with its bearer.

catalog.effectText: Genesis → Banish up to three cards from cemeteries. If any are Demons, this becomes one and gains +2 power permanently.

catalog.effectText: At the end of your turn, Regurgitator must either fill its empty belly by banishing a dead minion, or empty its full belly by shooting a projectile that deals damage equal to the eaten minion's power.

catalog.name: Release the Hounds
catalog.effectText: Summon two Hellhounds from your collection to your Avatar's location. They gain Charge this turn.
catalog.flavorText: Cry 'Havoc!', and let slip the dogs of war. — Shakespeare

catalog.name: Renatus Trueblood
catalog.effectText:
Airborne

Renatus Trueblood's strike damage against units heals you.

catalog.name: Return to Nature
catalog.effectText: Return up to three cards from a cemetery to the bottom of their decks. Draw a spell.
catalog.flavorText: Bone to blossom, sorrow to simple soil—the earth accepts all.

catalog.name: Returned King
catalog.effectText:
Other Undead have +1 power.

You control all Undead.

catalog.name: Revered Revenant
catalog.effectText: Has 0 power unless adjacent to an allied Ward.
catalog.flavorText: What power death takes, divine purpose returns.

catalog.name: River of Blood
catalog.effectText: All healing is halved, rounded down.

catalog.name: River Rapids
catalog.effectText: Once on your turn, you may push a minion on connected Rivers one step.

catalog.name: Road to Perdition
catalog.effectText: Genesis → Target nearby Evil gains or loses 1 power this turn.

catalog.name: Rowdy Boys
catalog.effectText: Untaps after striking Undead.
catalog.flavorText:
Johnny, Timmy, 'n Spike went down
To rattle bones outside of town.
First skull dusted named the winner—
Three more each and home to dinner!

catalog.name: Rubble
catalog.effectText: Provides no mana.

catalog.name: Sacred Stag
catalog.effectText:
Ward

Deathrite → You may Ward this site.
catalog.flavorText:
The stag came softly through the trees,
A crown of branching sky—
Scarce paused, as if such sights as these
Were made to pass us by.

catalog.name: Saint of Redemption
catalog.effectText:
Ward

No minion is Evil, but all enter the realm tapped.

catalog.name: Saintweald
catalog.effectText: Deathrite abilities here are also Genesis abilities.

catalog.name: Salt the Earth
catalog.effectText:
Conjure Salt the Earth to a single site, destroying it.

Sites can't be played here.

catalog.name: Satanic Panic
catalog.effectText: Kill all Demons, and one other target minion.
catalog.flavorText: Better wrong together than right alone.

catalog.name: Savior
catalog.effectText:
Tap → Play or draw a site.

(1) → Ward a minion that was summoned this turn.

catalog.name: Sawbones
catalog.effectText: If a nearby allied minion survives damage, fully heal it.

catalog.name: Scatter
catalog.effectText: Push everything at target location one step, one at a time.

catalog.name: Screamer
catalog.effectText: Genesis → Tap target adjacent enemy minion and make it take a step away.

catalog.name: Sea of Ash
catalog.effectText: Minions below nearby sites die.

catalog.name: Sea Witch
catalog.effectText: Spellcaster, Submerge
catalog.flavorText: The sea drapes her in kelp and coral, crowns her in conch and serpent-braid, and set its shoals to dancing at her feet.

catalog.name: Search Party
catalog.effectText: Has +1 power for each Search Party in your cemetery.
catalog.flavorText: For every soul the darkness claims, two more fools take up the search.

catalog.name: Searing Truth
catalog.effectText: Target player draws and reveals two spells, then takes damage equal to the higher mana cost.
catalog.flavorText: The ecstasy of knowing is surpassed only by the agony of surviving.

catalog.name: Second Wind
catalog.effectText:
An allied minion takes a step.

You may cast this spell from your cemetery, banishing it afterward.

catalog.name: Sensu of the Fang
catalog.effectText: Bearer has +1 power and is an Air Spellcaster.

catalog.name: Sentinel Trap
catalog.effectText: At the end of each turn, Sentinel Trap deals 4 damage to each unit at the adjacent location it's facing, then rotates 90 degrees clockwise.

catalog.name: Seraphim
catalog.effectText:
Airborne, Ward

At the end of your turn, you may transfer a nearby Ward onto a nearby minion or site.

catalog.name: Serava Townsfolk
catalog.flavorText: Rest and remember, for here the waters carry both sorrow and hope.

catalog.name: Sewer Rats
catalog.effectText:
May be cast under any site.

Burrowing, Submerge
catalog.flavorText: I hear them squeaking in the night... Please, adventurer, descend into the sewer and slay ten rats.

catalog.name: Shackled Demon
catalog.effectText: Disabled until an adjacent Spellcaster taps to release him.
catalog.flavorText: When the bonds break, the heavens will fall.

catalog.name: Shallow Grave
catalog.effectText: Genesis → Discard your top two spells.

catalog.name: Shoggoth
catalog.effectText: Submerge, Voidwalk
catalog.flavorText: Still came that eldritch, mocking cry—"Tekeli-li! Tekeli-li!"

catalog.name: Shrike Orchard
catalog.effectText: Whenever you summon a minion here, kill target nearby enemy Beast with 2 or less power.

catalog.name: Silent Hills
catalog.effectText: Genesis → Until your next turn, minions are silenced while atop nearby sites.

catalog.name: Silver Bullet
catalog.effectText: Bearer has "Tap, Sacrifice Silver Bullet -> This unit may cast an Exceptional spell from your collection."

catalog.name: Sinister Pond
catalog.effectText: Mortals here may transform into Evil from hand by paying the difference in cost.

catalog.name: Sinterfee
catalog.effectText: Genesis -> Target adjacent site is silenced and provides no threshold while Sinterfee is in the realm.

catalog.name: Sister Stefánia
catalog.effectText:
Ward

Other nearby minions are silenced.
catalog.flavorText: Poor sister, I fear her long-standing duties at the asylum have ...affected her.

catalog.name: Sjaelström
catalog.effectText: Banish all nearby Spirits and auras. Draw a spell for each.
catalog.flavorText: The storm howled in tongues, each gust crying a name long forgotten.

catalog.name: Skeleton
catalog.effectText: Can't move to defend.

catalog.name: Skeleton Mage
catalog.effectText:
Spellcaster

Genesis → May cast an Ordinary magic from a cemetery, banishing it afterward.
catalog.flavorText: Its fingers still trace patterns of forgotten charms.

catalog.name: Slimy Mutants
catalog.effectText:
Submerge

(3) → Transform an ally with Submerge into Slimy Mutants from your hand.
catalog.flavorText: The little croaking Frog was gone, unconscious of the carnage done.

catalog.name: Slobbermaw
catalog.effectText: Genesis → Sacrifice a minion or Slobbermaw deals 4 damage to you.
catalog.flavorText: Impicky and impatient. Watch your fingers!

catalog.name: Smite
catalog.effectText:
May be cast by any ally.

Strike target adjacent enemy. If it's Evil, banish it instead.

catalog.name: Snallygaster
catalog.effectText: Movement +1

catalog.name: Sold-out Cemetery
catalog.effectText: Whenever Undead enter this site, push another Undead here away one step.

catalog.name: Sow the Earth
catalog.effectText:
Conjure Sow the Earth to a single void square, playing your top site there.

This site provides double mana and threshold.

catalog.name: Sphere of Animosity
catalog.effectText: Avatars here can't leave, heal, or be defended.

catalog.name: Sphinx Sarcophagus
catalog.effectText: Genesis → Banish two identical spells from cemeteries to draw a spell.

catalog.name: Spire
catalog.flavorText: But hush, the wild, insistent trill of the air's sheer ecstasy.

catalog.name: Spore Spouts
catalog.effectText: Genesis → You can cast minions with 2 or less power to any site this turn.

catalog.name: Stagecoach
catalog.effectText:
Charge

May carry any number of minions.
catalog.flavorText: The road is long, but the fare is paid.

catalog.name: Stargazer
catalog.effectText: Genesis → Draw a spell for each minion in the void.
catalog.flavorText: The shapes we see in stars are more than just stories.

catalog.name: Static Servant
catalog.effectText: Genesis → Each other unit here takes 1 damage.

catalog.name: Stinging Kelp
catalog.effectText: Genesis → Deal 1 damage to each minion at target site in this body of water.

catalog.effectText: Genesis → Banish up to three minions from one cemetery to stitch together. This Abomination has their combined power, but each part may be damaged and destroyed separately.
catalog.flavorText: The sum of all fears, sewn with thread and blasphemy.

catalog.name: Stream
catalog.flavorText: But hark, the soft, insistent song as the water seeks the sea.

catalog.name: Sturmgeist
catalog.effectText:
Airborne

Whenever an enemy casts magic, Sturmgeist steps closer then strikes it if adjacent.

catalog.name: Stygian Archers
catalog.effectText:
Ranged

Whenever Stygian Archers kill an enemy, summon a Skeleton token where it died.

catalog.name: Survivors of Serava
catalog.effectText: At the end of your turn, if no enemies are nearby, this gains Stealth.
catalog.flavorText: The snow buries their road, their names, their regrets.

catalog.flavorText: Order of the Golden Scepter sounds awfully close to "Horde of the Gored Septarch." Good luck explaining that!

catalog.name: Symmetric Suffering
catalog.effectText: Sacrifice up to one minion, artifact, and aura. Your opponent must sacrifice the same.

catalog.name: Tabula Rasa
catalog.effectText:
May be cast to any minion.

Bearer is silenced, can't be modified otherwise, and can't drop Tabula Rasa.

catalog.name: Temple of Moloch
catalog.effectText: Once on each player's turn, they may sacrifice a minion here to gain (2).

catalog.name: Ten-tonne Slug
catalog.flavorText:
It bade no roar, but crept as stone
Of chiliad winters heaped as one
Wrothe belly o'er burg, bosk, and bone
'Til Time herself was unbegun

catalog.name: The Apex of Babel
catalog.effectText: When the Tower of Babel is built, draw a spell, then you may cast a spell for free.

catalog.name: The Base of Babel
catalog.effectText: You may build The Tower of Babel by playing The Apex of Babel atop this.

catalog.name: The Doom of Dilmun
catalog.effectText:
Burrowing, Submerge, Voidwalk

Can't be banished, destroyed, or modified.

catalog.name: The Empyrean
catalog.effectText: Provides (A)(E)(F)(W) if you control a nearby Angel or Ward.

catalog.name: The Flood
catalog.effectText: Permanently flood the entire realm, including voids. Submerge everything except one minion of each type.

catalog.name: The Hexham Haunts
catalog.effectText:
Airborne, Burrowing

Must be cast burrowed, but may be cast from the cemetery.
